+theorem phi_range (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) :
+    0 < phi α ∧ phi α < 1 - Real.log 2 := by
+  let β : ℝ := 1 - α
+  have hb0 : 0 < β := by dsimp [β]; linarith
+  have hb1 : β < 1 := by dsimp [β]; linarith
+  have hbp : 0 < 1 + β := by linarith
+  have hl0 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
+  have hl1 : Real.log 2 < 1 := by linarith [Real.log_two_lt_d9]
+  have hlog : Real.log (1 / 2 : ℝ) = -Real.log 2 := by
+    rw [one_div, Real.log_inv]
+  let q : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => (1 + z) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ z
+  let dq : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => (1 - (1 + z) * Real.log 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ z
+  let ddq : ℝ → ℝ := fun z =>
+    Real.log 2 * ((1 + z) * Real.log 2 - 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ z
+  have hd (z : ℝ) : HasDerivAt q (dq z) z := by
+    have h := ((hasDerivAt_const z 1).add (hasDerivAt_id z)).mul
+      ((hasDerivAt_id z).const_rpow (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2))
+    convert h using 1 <;> dsimp [q, dq] <;> simp only [hlog] <;> ring
+  have hdd (z : ℝ) : HasDerivAt dq (ddq z) z := by
+    have h := ((hasDerivAt_const z 1).sub
+      (((hasDerivAt_const z 1).add (hasDerivAt_id z)).mul_const (Real.log 2))).mul
+      ((hasDerivAt_id z).const_rpow (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2))
+    convert h using 1 <;> dsimp [dq, ddq] <;> simp only [hlog] <;> ring
+  have hconc : ConcaveOn ℝ (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) q := by
+    apply concaveOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt2_nonpos (convex_Icc 0 1)
+      (fun z hz => (hd z).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
+      (fun z hz => (hd z).hasDerivWithinAt)
+      (fun z hz => (hdd z).hasDerivWithinAt)
+    intro z hz
+    have hz1 : z ≤ 1 := (interior_subset hz).2
+    have hneg : (1 + z) * Real.log 2 - 2 ≤ 0 := by nlinarith
+    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg
+      (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hl0.le hneg)
+      (Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num) z)
+  have hbern : (2 : ℝ) ^ β < 1 + β := by
+    convert rpow_one_add_lt_one_add_mul_self
+      (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 1) (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hb0 hb1 using 1 <;> norm_num
+  have hp : 0 < (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ β := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) β
+  have hprod : (2 : ℝ) ^ β * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ β = 1 := by
+    rw [← Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)]
+    norm_num
+  have hq : 1 < q β := by
+    have hm := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hbern hp
+    dsimp [q]
+    rwa [hprod] at hm
+  have hphi : phi α = (q β - 1) / (β * (1 + β)) := by
+    dsimp [phi, q]
+    rw [show 1 - α = β by rfl, show 2 - α = 1 + β by dsimp [β]; ring]
+    field_simp
+    <;> ring
+  have hs : (q β - 1) / β ≤ 1 - Real.log 2 := by
+    simpa [slope_def_field, q, dq] using
+      hconc.slope_le_of_hasDerivAt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc 0 1)
+        (show β ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 from ⟨hb0.le, hb1.le⟩) hb0 (hd 0)
+  constructor
+  · rw [hphi]
+    exact div_pos (sub_pos.mpr hq) (mul_pos hb0 hbp)
+  · rw [hphi, div_lt_iff₀ (mul_pos hb0 hbp)]
+    have hnum := (div_le_iff₀ hb0).mp hs
+    have hc : 0 < (1 - Real.log 2) * β := mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hl1) hb0
+    nlinarith
+
+end BanditRL.OnlineUnboundedOSD

+theorem switching_scalar_regret_identity (α : ℝ) (T : ℕ) :
+    BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent.regret BanditRL.OnlineHuber.fullSpace (powerSteps α)
+      (fun t z => (switchLoss T (1 : ℝ) t z : EReal)) 0 0 T =
+      -((((T + 1) / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) - ((T / 2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
+        (∑ i ∈ range ((T + 1) / 2), powerSteps α i) +
+      (∑ i ∈ range T, ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (1 - α)) -
+      (T : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ Ico ((T + 1) / 2) T, powerSteps α i) := by
+  classical
+  have hin (a b : ℝ) : inner ℝ a b = b * a := rfl
+  let m : ℕ := (T + 1) / 2
+  let k : ℕ := T / 2
+  have hmT : m ≤ T := by dsimp [m]; omega
+  have hmk : m + k = T := by dsimp [m, k]; omega
+  have hcast : (T : ℝ) = (m : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hmk.symm
+  have hc (n : ℕ) : (∑ t ∈ range n, switchSlope T t) =
+      (n : ℝ) - 2 * ((min n m : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
+    induction n with
+    | zero => simp
+    | succ n ih =>
+      rw [sum_range_succ, ih]
+      by_cases hn : n < m
+      · rw [show switchSlope T n = -1 by change (if n < m then (-1 : ℝ) else 1) = -1; exact if_pos hn,
+          min_eq_left (Nat.le_of_lt hn), min_eq_left (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hn)]
+        push_cast
+        ring
+      · have hmn : m ≤ n := Nat.le_of_not_gt hn
+        rw [show switchSlope T n = 1 by change (if n < m then (-1 : ℝ) else 1) = 1; exact if_neg hn,
+          min_eq_right hmn, min_eq_right (hmn.trans (Nat.le_succ n))]
+        push_cast
+        ring
+  have hsuf (i : ℕ) (hi : i < T) : (∑ t ∈ Ico (i + 1) T, switchSlope T t) =
+      (T : ℝ) - 2 * (m : ℝ) - (((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) - 2 * ((min (i + 1) m : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
+    rw [sum_Ico_eq_sub _ (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi), hc T, hc (i + 1), min_eq_right hmT]
+  have hrun (t : ℕ) :
+      BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent.iterate BanditRL.OnlineHuber.fullSpace (powerSteps α)
+        (fun s z => (switchLoss T (1 : ℝ) s z : EReal)) 0 t =
+      -(∑ i ∈ range t, powerSteps α i * switchSlope T i) := by
+    have hloss : (fun (s : ℕ) (z : ℝ) => (switchLoss T (1 : ℝ) s z : EReal)) =
+        (fun s z => ((inner ℝ (switchSlope T s : ℝ) z + 0 : ℝ) : EReal)) := by
+      funext s z
+      simp [switchLoss, hin, mul_comm]
+    rw [hloss, iterate_affine_prefix]
+    simp
+  have hreg :
+      BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent.regret BanditRL.OnlineHuber.fullSpace (powerSteps α)
+        (fun t z => (switchLoss T (1 : ℝ) t z : EReal)) 0 0 T =
+      -(∑ i ∈ range T, powerSteps α i * switchSlope T i *
+        (∑ t ∈ Ico (i + 1) T, switchSlope T t)) := by
+    unfold BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent.regret
+    simp only [EReal.toReal_coe]
+    simp_rw [hrun]
+    simp only [switchLoss, hin, mul_one, mul_zero, sub_zero]
+    calc
+      _ = -(∑ t ∈ Ico 0 T, ∑ i ∈ Ico 0 t,
+          powerSteps α i * switchSlope T i * switchSlope T t) := by
+        simp only [Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range, mul_neg, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
+        congr 1
+        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+        intro t ht
+        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+        intro i hi
+        ring
+      _ = -(∑ i ∈ range T, powerSteps α i * switchSlope T i *
+          (∑ t ∈ Ico (i + 1) T, switchSlope T t)) := by
+        rw [← Finset.sum_Ico_Ico_comm' 0 T
+          (fun i t => powerSteps α i * switchSlope T i * switchSlope T t)]
+        simp only [Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range, Finset.mul_sum]
+  have hfirst : -(∑ i ∈ range m, powerSteps α i * switchSlope T i *
+      (∑ t ∈ Ico (i + 1) T, switchSlope T t)) =
+      (∑ i ∈ range m, ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * powerSteps α i) -
+        ((m : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)) * (∑ i ∈ range m, powerSteps α i) := by
+    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro i hi
+    have him : i < m := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
+    rw [hsuf i (him.trans_le hmT),
+      show switchSlope T i = -1 by change (if i < m then (-1 : ℝ) else 1) = -1; exact if_pos him,
+      min_eq_left (Nat.succ_le_of_lt him)]
+    push_cast
+    rw [hcast]
+    ring
+  have hlast : -(∑ i ∈ Ico m T, powerSteps α i * switchSlope T i *
+      (∑ t ∈ Ico (i + 1) T, switchSlope T t)) =
+      (∑ i ∈ Ico m T, ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * powerSteps α i) -
+        (T : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ Ico m T, powerSteps α i) := by
+    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
+    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+    intro i hi
+    have him : m ≤ i := (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi).1
+    rw [hsuf i (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hi).2,
+      show switchSlope T i = 1 by change (if i < m then (-1 : ℝ) else 1) = 1; exact if_neg (not_lt.mpr him),
+      min_eq_right (him.trans (Nat.le_succ i))]
+    push_cast
+    ring
+  have hpow (i : ℕ) : ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * powerSteps α i =
+      ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (1 - α) := by
+    unfold powerSteps
+    rw [show 1 - α = 1 + (-α) by ring,
+      Real.rpow_add (by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos i), Real.rpow_one]
+  calc
+    _ = -(∑ i ∈ range m, powerSteps α i * switchSlope T i *
+          (∑ t ∈ Ico (i + 1) T, switchSlope T t)) -
+        (∑ i ∈ Ico m T, powerSteps α i * switchSlope T i *
+          (∑ t ∈ Ico (i + 1) T, switchSlope T t)) := by
+      rw [hreg, ← Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico _ hmT]
+      ring
+    _ = -((m : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)) * (∑ i ∈ range m, powerSteps α i) +
+        (∑ i ∈ range T, ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (1 - α)) -
+        (T : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ Ico m T, powerSteps α i) := by
+      rw [sub_eq_add_neg, hfirst, hlast]
+      rw [← Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico (fun i => ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (1 - α)) hmT]
+      simp_rw [← hpow]
+      ring
+
+end BanditRL.OnlineUnboundedOSD

+theorem switching_scalar_lower_bound (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1)
+    (T : ℕ) (hT : 2 / ((1 - α) * phi α) ≤ (T : ℝ)) :
+    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * phi α * (T : ℝ) ^ (2 - α) ≤
+      BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent.regret BanditRL.OnlineHuber.fullSpace (powerSteps α)
+      (fun t z => (switchLoss T (1 : ℝ) t z : EReal)) 0 0 T := by
+  classical
+  let β : ℝ := 1 - α
+  let m : ℕ := (T + 1) / 2
+  let k : ℕ := T / 2
+  have hb0 : 0 < β := by dsimp [β]; linarith
+  have hb1 : β < 1 := by dsimp [β]; linarith
+  have hbp : 0 < β + 1 := by linarith
+  have hφ := phi_range α hα0 hα1
+  have hφ1 : phi α < 1 := by linarith [Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)]
+  have hden : 0 < β * phi α := mul_pos hb0 hφ.1
+  have hden1 : β * phi α < 1 :=
+    (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hb1 hφ.1).trans (by simpa using hφ1)
+  have hth : 2 ≤ (T : ℝ) * (β * phi α) := (div_le_iff₀ hden).mp hT
+  have hT2 : 2 ≤ T := by
+    by_contra hn
+    have hn1 : T ≤ 1 := by omega
+    have hnR : (T : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hn1
+    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnR hden.le
+    nlinarith
+  have hTpos : (0 : ℝ) < T := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < T by omega)
+  have hm1 : 1 ≤ m := by dsimp [m]; omega
+  have hmT : m ≤ T := by dsimp [m]; omega
+  have hmhalf : (T : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (m : ℝ) := by
+    have hn : T ≤ 2 * m := by dsimp [m]; omega
+    have h : (T : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
+    linarith
+  have hdiff0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) := by
+    have h : k ≤ m := by dsimp [m, k]; omega
+    exact sub_nonneg.mpr (by exact_mod_cast h)
+  have hdiff1 : (m : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
+    have h : m ≤ k + 1 := by dsimp [m, k]; omega
+    have hR : (m : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast h
+    linarith
+  have hanti (a b : ℕ) (ha : 1 ≤ a) :
+      AntitoneOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (-α)) (Set.Icc (a : ℝ) b) := by
+    apply (Real.antitoneOn_rpow_Ioi_of_exponent_nonpos (neg_nonpos.mpr hα0.le)).mono
+    intro x hx
+    have haR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ a := by exact_mod_cast ha
+    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (haR.trans hx.1)
+  have hsumfirst : (∑ i ∈ range m, powerSteps α i) ≤
+      1 + ((m : ℝ) ^ β - 1) / β := by
+    have h := (hanti 1 m (by omega)).sum_le_integral_Ico hm1
+    rw [integral_rpow (Or.inl (by linarith : -1 < -α))] at h
+    simp only [show -α + 1 = β by dsimp [β]; ring, Nat.cast_one, Real.one_rpow] at h
+    have he := Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico (powerSteps α) hm1
+    have hz : (∑ i ∈ range 1, powerSteps α i) = 1 := by norm_num [powerSteps]
+    rw [hz] at he
+    change (∑ i ∈ Ico 1 m, powerSteps α i) ≤ _ at h
+    linarith
+  have hsummain : (T : ℝ) ^ (β + 1) / (β + 1) ≤
+      ∑ i ∈ range T, ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ β := by
+    have hm : MonotoneOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ β) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
+      (Real.monotoneOn_rpow_Ici_of_exponent_nonneg hb0.le).mono
+        (fun x hx => hx.1)
+    have hm' : MonotoneOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ β) (Set.Icc ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) T) := by simpa using hm
+    have h := hm'.integral_le_sum_Ico (Nat.zero_le T)
+    rw [integral_rpow (Or.inl (by linarith : -1 < β)), Nat.cast_zero,
+      Real.zero_rpow hbp.ne', sub_zero, Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range] at h
+    exact h
+  have hsumlast : (∑ i ∈ Ico m T, powerSteps α i) ≤
+      ((T : ℝ) ^ β - (m : ℝ) ^ β) / β := by
+    have h := (hanti m T hm1).sum_le_integral_Ico hmT
+    rw [integral_rpow (Or.inl (by linarith : -1 < -α))] at h
+    simpa only [show -α + 1 = β by dsimp [β]; ring, powerSteps] using h
+  have hSnonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ range m, powerSteps α i :=
+    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i hi => (powerSteps_pos α i).le)
+  have hc : ((m : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)) * (∑ i ∈ range m, powerSteps α i) ≤
+      1 + ((m : ℝ) ^ β - 1) / β := by
+    calc
+      _ ≤ 1 * (∑ i ∈ range m, powerSteps α i) :=
+        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdiff1 hSnonneg
+      _ ≤ _ := by simpa using hsumfirst
+  have hlast := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsumlast hTpos.le
+  have hreg : -1 - ((m : ℝ) ^ β - 1) / β +
+      (T : ℝ) ^ (β + 1) / (β + 1) -
+      (T : ℝ) * (((T : ℝ) ^ β - (m : ℝ) ^ β) / β) ≤
+      BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent.regret BanditRL.OnlineHuber.fullSpace (powerSteps α)
+        (fun t z => (switchLoss T (1 : ℝ) t z : EReal)) 0 0 T := by
+    rw [switching_scalar_regret_identity]
+    change _ ≤ -((m : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)) * (∑ i ∈ range m, powerSteps α i) +
+      (∑ i ∈ range T, ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ β) -
+      (T : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ Ico m T, powerSteps α i)
+    linarith
+  have hpupper : (m : ℝ) ^ β ≤ (T : ℝ) ^ β :=
+    Real.rpow_le_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg m) (by exact_mod_cast hmT) hb0.le
+  have hplower : ((T : ℝ) / 2) ^ β ≤ (m : ℝ) ^ β :=
+    Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) hmhalf hb0.le

+"""Gate recorder reused for unbounded OGD, Python3.8 stdlib; no gate executed by preparation."""
+import argparse
+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import zipfile
+
+
+def utc():
+    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+
+
+def digest(data):
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def create(path, data):
+    if not isinstance(data, bytes):
+        data = (json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
+    with path.open("xb") as stream:
+        stream.write(data)
+
+
+def git(root, *args):
+    proc = subprocess.run(["git"] + list(args), cwd=str(root), stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                          stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+    if proc.returncode:
+        raise RuntimeError("git failed: " + repr(args) + ": " + proc.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace"))
+    return proc.stdout
+
+
+def state(root):
+    return {"HEAD": git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip(),
+            "branch": git(root, "branch", "--show-current").decode().strip(),
+            "status_porcelain_v1_z_hex": git(root, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z").hex()}
+
+
+def inventory(root, run, owned):
+    # Start with tracked names, then explicitly filter to current source/input trees below.
+    names = set(x.decode("utf-8") for x in git(root, "ls-files", "-z", "--cached").split(b"\0") if x)
+    # Add new source paths, including ignored additions inside actual source trees.
+    for folder in ("BanditRLProof", "Tests", "tools", "website/scripts", "website/content",
+                   "website/static", "research-wiki/contribution-contracts"):
+        for path in (root / folder).rglob("*"):
+            if path.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in path.parts:
+                names.add(path.relative_to(root).as_posix())
+    for name in ("BanditRLProof.lean", "Tests.lean", "lean-toolchain", "lakefile.lean",
+                 "lake-manifest.json", ".gitattributes"):
+        names.add(name)
+    names.update(owned)
+    contract_roots = [name.rsplit("/", 1)[0] for name in owned if name.startswith("docs/contracts/")]
+    extra = {"README.md", "AGENTS.md", "CONTRIBUTING.md", "docs/contribution-contract.schema.json", "docs/contributor-codex-contract.md", "docs/theorem-publication-protocol.md", "docs/contracts/online-book-v1/coverage.json"}
+    names = {name for name in names if selected_for_zip(name, contract_roots) or name in extra}
+    result = []
+    for name in sorted(names):
+        path = root / name
+        resolved = path.resolve()
+        if resolved == run or run in resolved.parents:
+            continue
+        if root not in resolved.parents or path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
+            raise RuntimeError("Input must be an existing ordinary repository file: " + name)
+        data = path.read_bytes()
+        result.append({"path": name, "raw_sha256": digest(data), "bytes": len(data)})
+    return result
+
+
+def selected_for_zip(name, contract_roots):
+    # Historical runs are excluded from both selected RAW inventory and ZIP; clean HEAD binds them.
+    if name.startswith("runs/"):
+        return False
+    prefixes = ("BanditRLProof/", "Tests/", "tools/", "website/scripts/",
+                "website/content/", "website/static/", "research-wiki/contribution-contracts/")
+    exact = {"BanditRLProof.lean", "Tests.lean", "lean-toolchain", "lakefile.lean",
+             "lake-manifest.json", ".gitattributes"}
+    return (name in exact or name.startswith(prefixes) or
+            any(name.startswith(folder.rstrip("/") + "/") for folder in contract_roots))
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--root", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--run", required=True, help="New evidence namespace beneath runs/ or an already ignored tmp/ namespace")
+    parser.add_argument("--label", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--owned-source", action="append", default=[])
+    parser.add_argument("--leaf-contract", action="append", required=True,
+                        help="Current leaf docs/contracts subtree to include in ZIP")
+    parser.add_argument("argv", nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    root = Path(args.root).resolve()
+    run = (root / args.run).resolve()
+    argv = args.argv[1:] if args.argv[:1] == ["--"] else args.argv
+    if not argv or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*", args.label):
+        raise RuntimeError("Exact argv and safe unique label required")
+    if root / "runs" not in run.parents and root / "tmp" not in run.parents:
+        raise RuntimeError("Evidence namespace must be beneath root/runs/ or root/tmp/")
+    if root / "tmp" in run.parents:
+        probe = run.relative_to(root).as_posix() + "/.capture-ignore-probe"
+        result = subprocess.run(["git", "check-ignore", "--quiet", "--", probe],
+                                cwd=str(root), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+        if result.returncode != 0:
+            raise RuntimeError("tmp evidence namespace must already be ignored; no ignore rule changes permitted")
+    for folder in args.leaf_contract:
+        resolved = (root / folder).resolve()
+        if root / "docs" / "contracts" not in resolved.parents:
+            raise RuntimeError("Leaf contract must be a docs/contracts subtree")
+        if not resolved.is_dir():
+            raise RuntimeError("Leaf contract subtree missing")
+        args.owned_source.extend(path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
+                                 for path in resolved.rglob("*") if path.is_file())
+    dest = run / args.label
+    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    helper = Path(__file__).resolve().read_bytes()
+    create(dest / "capture-helper.py.txt", helper)
+    record = {"argv": argv, "cwd": str(root), "helper_sha256": digest(helper),
+              "evidence_namespace_excluded": run.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
+              "actual_evidence_namespace": str(run),
+              "evidence_port_boundary": "Receipts originate here; any later exact copy into RUN requires a separate port manifest. No contemporaneous canonical RUN claim.",
+              "owned_source": args.owned_source, "command_started": False, "actual_exit": None,
+              "ZIP_is_whole_repository_archive": False,
+              "ZIP_scope": "Selected active source/input trees and current leaf contracts; all historical runs excluded",
+              "full_RAW_inventory_scope": "Every library/Test source and enumerated current harness/site source/input tree plus current leaf contracts. Historical archives not separately RAW-hashed; committed HEAD and clean Git status bind repository state.",
+              "leaf_contract_roots": args.leaf_contract}
+    try:
+        before = inventory(root, run, args.owned_source)
+        record["pre_git"] = state(root)
+        if record["pre_git"]["status_porcelain_v1_z_hex"]:
+            raise RuntimeError("Clean committed candidate required before gate")
+        create(dest / "pre-source-inputs.json", before)
+        selected = [row for row in before if selected_for_zip(row["path"], args.leaf_contract)]
+        create(dest / "pre-selected-ZIP-inputs.json", selected)
+        record["ZIP_selected_files"] = len(selected)
+        record["full_RAW_inventory_files"] = len(before)
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(str(dest / "pre-selected-source-raw.zip"), "x", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
+            for row in selected:
+                data = (root / row["path"]).read_bytes()
+                if digest(data) != row["raw_sha256"]:
+                    raise RuntimeError("Source changed during snapshot: " + row["path"])
+                archive.writestr(row["path"], data)
+        if any(digest((root / row["path"]).read_bytes()) != row["raw_sha256"] for row in selected):
+            raise RuntimeError("Selected ZIP source changed before command")
+        if state(root) != record["pre_git"]:
+            raise RuntimeError("Git changed before command")
+        record["precommand_check"] = "Selected ZIP RAW hashes and Git state; no redundant second full inventory. Full pre/post manifests remain authoritative."
+        record["start_utc"] = utc()

+              "owned_source": args.owned_source, "command_started": False, "actual_exit": None,

+              "full_RAW_inventory_scope": "Every library/Test source and enumerated current harness/site source/input tree plus current leaf contracts. Historical archives not separately RAW-hashed; committed HEAD and clean Git status bind repository state.",
+              "leaf_contract_roots": args.leaf_contract}

+                    raise RuntimeError("Source changed during snapshot: " + row["path"])

+        record["start_utc"] = utc()

+            proc = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=str(root), stdout=out, stderr=err,

+        record["actual_exit"] = proc.returncode
+        after = inventory(root, run, args.owned_source)

+        record["capture_error"] = repr(exc)

+"""Gate recorder reused for unbounded OGD, Python3.8 stdlib; no gate executed by preparation."""

+    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

+

+        stream.write(data)

+                          stderr=subprocess.PIPE)

+        raise RuntimeError("git failed: " + repr(args) + ": " + proc.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace"))
+    return proc.stdout
+
+
+def state(root):
+    return {"HEAD": git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip(),
+            "branch": git(root, "branch", "--show-current").decode().strip(),
+            "status_porcelain_v1_z_hex": git(root, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z").hex()}
+
+
+def inventory(root, run, owned):
+    # Start with tracked names, then explicitly filter to current source/input trees below.
+    names = set(x.decode("utf-8") for x in git(root, "ls-files", "-z", "--cached").split(b"\0") if x)
+    # Add new source paths, including ignored additions inside actual source trees.
+    for folder in ("BanditRLProof", "Tests", "tools", "website/scripts", "website/content",
+                   "website/static", "research-wiki/contribution-contracts"):
+        for path in (root / folder).rglob("*"):
+            if path.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in path.parts:
+                names.add(path.relative_to(root).as_posix())
+    for name in ("BanditRLProof.lean", "Tests.lean", "lean-toolchain", "lakefile.lean",
+                 "lake-manifest.json", ".gitattributes"):
+        names.add(name)
+    names.update(owned)
+    contract_roots = [name.rsplit("/", 1)[0] for name in owned if name.startswith("docs/contracts/")]
+    extra = {"README.md", "AGENTS.md", "CONTRIBUTING.md", "docs/contribution-contract.schema.json", "docs/contributor-codex-contract.md", "docs/theorem-publication-protocol.md", "docs/contracts/online-book-v1/coverage.json"}
+    names = {name for name in names if selected_for_zip(name, contract_roots) or name in extra}
+    result = []
+    for name in sorted(names):
+        path = root / name
+        resolved = path.resolve()
+        if resolved == run or run in resolved.parents:
+            continue
+        if root not in resolved.parents or path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
+            raise RuntimeError("Input must be an existing ordinary repository file: " + name)

+
+

+    # Historical runs are excluded from both selected RAW inventory and ZIP; clean HEAD binds them.
+    if name.startswith("runs/"):
+        return False
+    prefixes = ("BanditRLProof/", "Tests/", "tools/", "website/scripts/",
+                "website/content/", "website/static/", "research-wiki/contribution-contracts/")
+    exact = {"BanditRLProof.lean", "Tests.lean", "lean-toolchain", "lakefile.lean",
+             "lake-manifest.json", ".gitattributes"}
+    return (name in exact or name.startswith(prefixes) or
+            any(name.startswith(folder.rstrip("/") + "/") for folder in contract_roots))
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--root", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--run", required=True, help="New evidence namespace beneath runs/ or an already ignored tmp/ namespace")
+    parser.add_argument("--label", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--owned-source", action="append", default=[])
+    parser.add_argument("--leaf-contract", action="append", required=True,
+                        help="Current leaf docs/contracts subtree to include in ZIP")
+    parser.add_argument("argv", nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    root = Path(args.root).resolve()
+    run = (root / args.run).resolve()
+    argv = args.argv[1:] if args.argv[:1] == ["--"] else args.argv
+    if not argv or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*", args.label):
+        raise RuntimeError("Exact argv and safe unique label required")
+    if root / "runs" not in run.parents and root / "tmp" not in run.parents:
+        raise RuntimeError("Evidence namespace must be beneath root/runs/ or root/tmp/")
+    if root / "tmp" in run.parents:
+        probe = run.relative_to(root).as_posix() + "/.capture-ignore-probe"
+        result = subprocess.run(["git", "check-ignore", "--quiet", "--", probe],
+                                cwd=str(root), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+        if result.returncode != 0:
+            raise RuntimeError("tmp evidence namespace must already be ignored; no ignore rule changes permitted")

+        resolved = (root / folder).resolve()
+        if root / "docs" / "contracts" not in resolved.parents:
+            raise RuntimeError("Leaf contract must be a docs/contracts subtree")
+        if not resolved.is_dir():

+        args.owned_source.extend(path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
+                                 for path in resolved.rglob("*") if path.is_file())
+    dest = run / args.label
+    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    helper = Path(__file__).resolve().read_bytes()
+    create(dest / "capture-helper.py.txt", helper)
+    record = {"argv": argv, "cwd": str(root), "helper_sha256": digest(helper),
+              "evidence_namespace_excluded": run.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
+              "actual_evidence_namespace": str(run),
+              "evidence_port_boundary": "Receipts originate here; any later exact copy into RUN requires a separate port manifest. No contemporaneous canonical RUN claim.",
+              "owned_source": args.owned_source, "command_started": False, "actual_exit": None,
+              "ZIP_is_whole_repository_archive": False,
+              "ZIP_scope": "Selected active source/input trees and current leaf contracts; all historical runs excluded",
+              "full_RAW_inventory_scope": "Every library/Test source and enumerated current harness/site source/input tree plus current leaf contracts. Historical archives not separately RAW-hashed; committed HEAD and clean Git status bind repository state.",
+              "leaf_contract_roots": args.leaf_contract}
+    try:
+        before = inventory(root, run, args.owned_source)
+        record["pre_git"] = state(root)
+        if record["pre_git"]["status_porcelain_v1_z_hex"]:
+            raise RuntimeError("Clean committed candidate required before gate")
+        create(dest / "pre-source-inputs.json", before)
+        selected = [row for row in before if selected_for_zip(row["path"], args.leaf_contract)]
+        create(dest / "pre-selected-ZIP-inputs.json", selected)
+        record["ZIP_selected_files"] = len(selected)
+        record["full_RAW_inventory_files"] = len(before)
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(str(dest / "pre-selected-source-raw.zip"), "x", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
+            for row in selected:
+                data = (root / row["path"]).read_bytes()
+                if digest(data) != row["raw_sha256"]:
+                    raise RuntimeError("Source changed during snapshot: " + row["path"])
+                archive.writestr(row["path"], data)
+        if any(digest((root / row["path"]).read_bytes()) != row["raw_sha256"] for row in selected):
+            raise RuntimeError("Selected ZIP source changed before command")
+        if state(root) != record["pre_git"]:
+            raise RuntimeError("Git changed before command")
+        record["precommand_check"] = "Selected ZIP RAW hashes and Git state; no redundant second full inventory. Full pre/post manifests remain authoritative."
+        record["start_utc"] = utc()
+        record["command_started"] = True
+        with (dest / "stdout.raw").open("xb") as out, (dest / "stderr.raw").open("xb") as err:
+            proc = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=str(root), stdout=out, stderr=err,
+                                  env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1"))
+        record["end_utc"] = utc()
+        record["actual_exit"] = proc.returncode
+        after = inventory(root, run, args.owned_source)
+        create(dest / "post-source-inputs.json", after)
+        record["post_git"] = state(root)
+        record["complete_source_path_set_and_RAW_unchanged"] = before == after
+        record["HEAD_and_branch_unchanged"] = all(record["pre_git"][k] == record["post_git"][k]
+                                                 for k in ("HEAD", "branch"))
+        record["git_status_unchanged"] = record["pre_git"] == record["post_git"]
+        record["capture_integrity_ok"] = before == after and record["HEAD_and_branch_unchanged"] and record["git_status_unchanged"]
+    except Exception as exc:
+        record["capture_error"] = repr(exc)
+        record["capture_integrity_ok"] = False
+        record.setdefault("end_utc", utc())
+    for name in ("stdout.raw", "stderr.raw", "pre-source-inputs.json", "post-source-inputs.json",
+                 "pre-selected-ZIP-inputs.json", "pre-selected-source-raw.zip"):
+        path = dest / name
+        if path.exists():
+            record[name + "_sha256"] = digest(path.read_bytes())
+    create(dest / "receipt.json", record)
+    print(json.dumps({"receipt": str(dest / "receipt.json"), "actual_exit": record["actual_exit"],
+                      "capture_integrity_ok": record["capture_integrity_ok"]}))
+    if not record["capture_integrity_ok"]:
+        return 125
+    return record["actual_exit"] if record["actual_exit"] is not None else 125
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+def selected_for_zip(name, contract_roots):

+    if name.startswith("runs/"):

+    prefixes = ("BanditRLProof/", "Tests/", "tools/", "website/scripts/",
+                "website/content/", "website/static/", "research-wiki/contribution-contracts/")
+    exact = {"BanditRLProof.lean", "Tests.lean", "lean-toolchain", "lakefile.lean",
+             "lake-manifest.json", ".gitattributes"}
+    return (name in exact or name.startswith(prefixes) or
+            any(name.startswith(folder.rstrip("/") + "/") for folder in contract_roots))

+    parser.add_argument("--owned-source", action="append", default=[])
+    parser.add_argument("--leaf-contract", action="append", required=True,
+                        help="Current leaf docs/contracts subtree to include in ZIP")
+    parser.add_argument("argv", nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    root = Path(args.root).resolve()
+    run = (root / args.run).resolve()
+    argv = args.argv[1:] if args.argv[:1] == ["--"] else args.argv
+    if not argv or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*", args.label):

+    if root / "runs" not in run.parents and root / "tmp" not in run.parents:
+        raise RuntimeError("Evidence namespace must be beneath root/runs/ or root/tmp/")
+    if root / "tmp" in run.parents:
+        probe = run.relative_to(root).as_posix() + "/.capture-ignore-probe"

+            raise RuntimeError("tmp evidence namespace must already be ignored; no ignore rule changes permitted")
+    for folder in args.leaf_contract:
+        resolved = (root / folder).resolve()
+        if root / "docs" / "contracts" not in resolved.parents:
+            raise RuntimeError("Leaf contract must be a docs/contracts subtree")
+        if not resolved.is_dir():
+            raise RuntimeError("Leaf contract subtree missing")
+        args.owned_source.extend(path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
+                                 for path in resolved.rglob("*") if path.is_file())
+    dest = run / args.label
+    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    helper = Path(__file__).resolve().read_bytes()
+    create(dest / "capture-helper.py.txt", helper)
+    record = {"argv": argv, "cwd": str(root), "helper_sha256": digest(helper),
+              "evidence_namespace_excluded": run.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
+              "actual_evidence_namespace": str(run),
+              "evidence_port_boundary": "Receipts originate here; any later exact copy into RUN requires a separate port manifest. No contemporaneous canonical RUN claim.",
+              "owned_source": args.owned_source, "command_started": False, "actual_exit": None,
+              "ZIP_is_whole_repository_archive": False,
+              "ZIP_scope": "Selected active source/input trees and current leaf contracts; all historical runs excluded",
+              "full_RAW_inventory_scope": "Every library/Test source and enumerated current harness/site source/input tree plus current leaf contracts. Historical archives not separately RAW-hashed; committed HEAD and clean Git status bind repository state.",
+              "leaf_contract_roots": args.leaf_contract}
+    try:
+        before = inventory(root, run, args.owned_source)
+        record["pre_git"] = state(root)
+        if record["pre_git"]["status_porcelain_v1_z_hex"]:
+            raise RuntimeError("Clean committed candidate required before gate")
+        create(dest / "pre-source-inputs.json", before)
+        selected = [row for row in before if selected_for_zip(row["path"], args.leaf_contract)]
+        create(dest / "pre-selected-ZIP-inputs.json", selected)
+        record["ZIP_selected_files"] = len(selected)
+        record["full_RAW_inventory_files"] = len(before)
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(str(dest / "pre-selected-source-raw.zip"), "x", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
+            for row in selected:
+                data = (root / row["path"]).read_bytes()
+                if digest(data) != row["raw_sha256"]:
+                    raise RuntimeError("Source changed during snapshot: " + row["path"])
+                archive.writestr(row["path"], data)
+        if any(digest((root / row["path"]).read_bytes()) != row["raw_sha256"] for row in selected):
+            raise RuntimeError("Selected ZIP source changed before command")
+        if state(root) != record["pre_git"]:
+            raise RuntimeError("Git changed before command")
+        record["precommand_check"] = "Selected ZIP RAW hashes and Git state; no redundant second full inventory. Full pre/post manifests remain authoritative."
+        record["start_utc"] = utc()
+        record["command_started"] = True
+        with (dest / "stdout.raw").open("xb") as out, (dest / "stderr.raw").open("xb") as err:
+            proc = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=str(root), stdout=out, stderr=err,
+                                  env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1"))
+        record["end_utc"] = utc()
+        record["actual_exit"] = proc.returncode
+        after = inventory(root, run, args.owned_source)
+        create(dest / "post-source-inputs.json", after)
+        record["post_git"] = state(root)
+        record["complete_source_path_set_and_RAW_unchanged"] = before == after
+        record["HEAD_and_branch_unchanged"] = all(record["pre_git"][k] == record["post_git"][k]
+                                                 for k in ("HEAD", "branch"))
+        record["git_status_unchanged"] = record["pre_git"] == record["post_git"]
+        record["capture_integrity_ok"] = before == after and record["HEAD_and_branch_unchanged"] and record["git_status_unchanged"]

+        record["capture_integrity_ok"] = False
+        record.setdefault("end_utc", utc())
+    for name in ("stdout.raw", "stderr.raw", "pre-source-inputs.json", "post-source-inputs.json",

+        path = dest / name
+        if path.exists():
+            record[name + "_sha256"] = digest(path.read_bytes())
+    create(dest / "receipt.json", record)
+    print(json.dumps({"receipt": str(dest / "receipt.json"), "actual_exit": record["actual_exit"],
+                      "capture_integrity_ok": record["capture_integrity_ok"]}))
+    if not record["capture_integrity_ok"]:
+        return 125
+    return record["actual_exit"] if record["actual_exit"] is not None else 125

+    sys.exit(main())

Place in the proof
Chapter 2 printed14/PDF26 points to Section5.2. Theorem5.4 printed52–53/PDF64–65 literally states OSD; this result proves its explicit affine witness also drives actual OGD. Global differentiability is a proved strengthening of the witness regularity. Coordinate-free nontrivial finite-dimensional real inner-product spaces express the source Euclidean positive-dimensional construction. This is one specified polynomial schedule family, not every varying schedule or every learner.
Proof and Lean reading notes
Proof idea
Choose a unit vector v and m=ceil(T/2). Let loss_t(z)=-<v,z> for source t<=m and +<v,z> thereafter. Each loss is globally differentiable, convex and 1-Lipschitz. Its actual gradient and the canonical OSD selected subgradient both equal the signed unit vector. Induction identifies the two actual trajectories at every time; their pre-update regret sums agree. Apply the accepted switching_vector_lower_bound to obtain the same exact half-phi bound. The loss stream may depend on T; no fixed infinite witness or Tendsto theorem is asserted.

+import BanditRLProof.OnlineUnboundedOSD
+import BanditRLProof.OnlineGradientDescentSource
+import Mathlib.Tactic
+
+noncomputable section
+open Set Finset
+open scoped InnerProductSpace
+
+namespace BanditRL.OnlineUnboundedOSD
+def powerSteps (α : ℝ) (t : ℕ) : ℝ := ((t + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (-α)
+
+def phi (α : ℝ) : ℝ := 1 / (2 - α) + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - α) - 1) / (1 - α)
+
+end BanditRL.OnlineUnboundedOSD
+
+namespace BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent
+variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
+structure Domain (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] where
+  carrier : Set E
+  nonempty : carrier.Nonempty
+  closed : IsClosed carrier
+  convex : Convex ℝ carrier
+
+def project (V : Domain E) (z : E) : E :=
+  Classical.choose (exists_norm_eq_iInf_of_complete_convex V.nonempty
+    V.closed.isComplete V.convex z)
+
+def step (V : Domain E) (η : ℝ) (f : E → ℝ) (x : E) : E :=
+  project V (x - η • gradient f x)
+
+end BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent
+
+namespace BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent
+variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
+def iterateVariable (V : Domain E) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → ℝ) (x₁ : E) : ℕ → E
+  | 0 => x₁
+  | t + 1 => step V (η t) (loss t) (iterateVariable V η loss x₁ t)
+
+def regretVariable (V : Domain E) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → ℝ)
+    (x₁ u : E) (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
+  ∑ t ∈ range T, (loss t (iterateVariable V η loss x₁ t) - loss t u)
+
+end BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent
+
+namespace BanditRL.OnlineHuber
+variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
+open BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent
+def fullSpace : Domain E :=
+  ⟨Set.univ, Set.univ_nonempty, isClosed_univ, convex_univ⟩
+
+end BanditRL.OnlineHuber
+

+import BanditRLProof.OnlineUnboundedOSD
+import BanditRLProof.OnlineGradientDescentSource
+import Mathlib.Tactic
+
+noncomputable section
+open Set Finset
+open scoped InnerProductSpace
+namespace BanditRL.OnlineUnboundedOGD
+variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
+variable [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
+
+theorem regret_lower_bound [Nontrivial E] (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1)
+    (T : ℕ) (hT : 2 / ((1 - α) * BanditRL.OnlineUnboundedOSD.phi α) ≤ (T : ℝ)) :
+    ∃ loss : ℕ → E → ℝ,
+      (∀ t < T, ConvexOn ℝ univ (loss t) ∧ LipschitzWith 1 (loss t) ∧
+        Differentiable ℝ (loss t)) ∧
+      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * BanditRL.OnlineUnboundedOSD.phi α * (T : ℝ) ^ (2 - α) ≤
+        BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent.regretVariable BanditRL.OnlineHuber.fullSpace
+          (BanditRL.OnlineUnboundedOSD.powerSteps α) loss 0 0 T
+
+end BanditRL.OnlineUnboundedOGD

+              "evidence_port_boundary": "Receipts originate here; any later exact copy into RUN requires a separate port manifest. No contemporaneous canonical RUN claim.",
+              "owned_source": args.owned_source, "command_started": False, "actual_exit": None,
+              "ZIP_is_whole_repository_archive": False,
+              "ZIP_scope": "Selected active source/input trees and current leaf contracts; all historical runs excluded",
+              "full_RAW_inventory_scope": "Every library/Test source and enumerated current harness/site source/input tree plus current leaf contracts. Historical archives not separately RAW-hashed; committed HEAD and clean Git status bind repository state.",
+              "leaf_contract_roots": args.leaf_contract}
+    try:
+        before = inventory(root, run, args.owned_source)
+        record["pre_git"] = state(root)
+        if record["pre_git"]["status_porcelain_v1_z_hex"]:
+            raise RuntimeError("Clean committed candidate required before gate")
+        create(dest / "pre-source-inputs.json", before)
+        selected = [row for row in before if selected_for_zip(row["path"], args.leaf_contract)]
+        create(dest / "pre-selected-ZIP-inputs.json", selected)
+        record["ZIP_selected_files"] = len(selected)
+        record["full_RAW_inventory_files"] = len(before)
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(str(dest / "pre-selected-source-raw.zip"), "x", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
+            for row in selected:
+                data = (root / row["path"]).read_bytes()
+                if digest(data) != row["raw_sha256"]:
+                    raise RuntimeError("Source changed during snapshot: " + row["path"])
+                archive.writestr(row["path"], data)
+        if any(digest((root / row["path"]).read_bytes()) != row["raw_sha256"] for row in selected):
+            raise RuntimeError("Selected ZIP source changed before command")
+        if state(root) != record["pre_git"]:
+            raise RuntimeError("Git changed before command")
+        record["precommand_check"] = "Selected ZIP RAW hashes and Git state; no redundant second full inventory. Full pre/post manifests remain authoritative."
+        record["start_utc"] = utc()
+        record["command_started"] = True
+        with (dest / "stdout.raw").open("xb") as out, (dest / "stderr.raw").open("xb") as err:
+            proc = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=str(root), stdout=out, stderr=err,
+                                  env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1"))
+        record["end_utc"] = utc()
+        record["actual_exit"] = proc.returncode
+        after = inventory(root, run, args.owned_source)
+        create(dest / "post-source-inputs.json", after)
+        record["post_git"] = state(root)
+        record["complete_source_path_set_and_RAW_unchanged"] = before == after
+        record["HEAD_and_branch_unchanged"] = all(record["pre_git"][k] == record["post_git"][k]
+                                                 for k in ("HEAD", "branch"))
+        record["git_status_unchanged"] = record["pre_git"] == record["post_git"]
+        record["capture_integrity_ok"] = before == after and record["HEAD_and_branch_unchanged"] and record["git_status_unchanged"]
+    except Exception as exc:
+        record["capture_error"] = repr(exc)
+        record["capture_integrity_ok"] = False
+        record.setdefault("end_utc", utc())
+    for name in ("stdout.raw", "stderr.raw", "pre-source-inputs.json", "post-source-inputs.json",
+                 "pre-selected-ZIP-inputs.json", "pre-selected-source-raw.zip"):
+        path = dest / name
+        if path.exists():
+            record[name + "_sha256"] = digest(path.read_bytes())
+    create(dest / "receipt.json", record)
+    print(json.dumps({"receipt": str(dest / "receipt.json"), "actual_exit": record["actual_exit"],
+                      "capture_integrity_ok": record["capture_integrity_ok"]}))
+    if not record["capture_integrity_ok"]:
+        return 125
+    return record["actual_exit"] if record["actual_exit"] is not None else 125
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+"""Gate recorder reused for unbounded OGD, Python3.8 stdlib; no gate executed by preparation."""
+import argparse
+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import zipfile
+
+
+def utc():
+    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+
+
+def digest(data):
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def create(path, data):
+    if not isinstance(data, bytes):
+        data = (json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
+    with path.open("xb") as stream:
+        stream.write(data)
+
+
+def git(root, *args):
+    proc = subprocess.run(["git"] + list(args), cwd=str(root), stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                          stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+    if proc.returncode:
+        raise RuntimeError("git failed: " + repr(args) + ": " + proc.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace"))
+    return proc.stdout
+
+
+def state(root):
+    return {"HEAD": git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip(),
+            "branch": git(root, "branch", "--show-current").decode().strip(),
+            "status_porcelain_v1_z_hex": git(root, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z").hex()}
+
+
+def inventory(root, run, owned):
+    # Start with tracked names, then explicitly filter to current source/input trees below.
+    names = set(x.decode("utf-8") for x in git(root, "ls-files", "-z", "--cached").split(b"\0") if x)
+    # Add new source paths, including ignored additions inside actual source trees.
+    for folder in ("BanditRLProof", "Tests", "tools", "website/scripts", "website/content",
+                   "website/static", "research-wiki/contribution-contracts"):
+        for path in (root / folder).rglob("*"):
+            if path.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in path.parts:
+                names.add(path.relative_to(root).as_posix())
+    for name in ("BanditRLProof.lean", "Tests.lean", "lean-toolchain", "lakefile.lean",
+                 "lake-manifest.json", ".gitattributes"):
+        names.add(name)
+    names.update(owned)
+    contract_roots = [name.rsplit("/", 1)[0] for name in owned if name.startswith("docs/contracts/")]
+    extra = {"README.md", "AGENTS.md", "CONTRIBUTING.md", "docs/contribution-contract.schema.json", "docs/contributor-codex-contract.md", "docs/theorem-publication-protocol.md", "docs/contracts/online-book-v1/coverage.json"}
+    names = {name for name in names if selected_for_zip(name, contract_roots) or name in extra}
+    result = []
+    for name in sorted(names):
+        path = root / name
+        resolved = path.resolve()
+        if resolved == run or run in resolved.parents:
+            continue
+        if root not in resolved.parents or path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
+            raise RuntimeError("Input must be an existing ordinary repository file: " + name)
+        data = path.read_bytes()
+        result.append({"path": name, "raw_sha256": digest(data), "bytes": len(data)})
+    return result
+
+
+def selected_for_zip(name, contract_roots):
+    # Historical runs are excluded from both selected RAW inventory and ZIP; clean HEAD binds them.
+    if name.startswith("runs/"):
+        return False
+    prefixes = ("BanditRLProof/", "Tests/", "tools/", "website/scripts/",
+                "website/content/", "website/static/", "research-wiki/contribution-contracts/")
+    exact = {"BanditRLProof.lean", "Tests.lean", "lean-toolchain", "lakefile.lean",
+             "lake-manifest.json", ".gitattributes"}
+    return (name in exact or name.startswith(prefixes) or
+            any(name.startswith(folder.rstrip("/") + "/") for folder in contract_roots))
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--root", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--run", required=True, help="New evidence namespace beneath runs/ or an already ignored tmp/ namespace")
+    parser.add_argument("--label", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--owned-source", action="append", default=[])
+    parser.add_argument("--leaf-contract", action="append", required=True,
+                        help="Current leaf docs/contracts subtree to include in ZIP")
+    parser.add_argument("argv", nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    root = Path(args.root).resolve()
+    run = (root / args.run).resolve()
+    argv = args.argv[1:] if args.argv[:1] == ["--"] else args.argv
+    if not argv or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*", args.label):
+        raise RuntimeError("Exact argv and safe unique label required")
+    if root / "runs" not in run.parents and root / "tmp" not in run.parents:
+        raise RuntimeError("Evidence namespace must be beneath root/runs/ or root/tmp/")
+    if root / "tmp" in run.parents:
+        probe = run.relative_to(root).as_posix() + "/.capture-ignore-probe"
+        result = subprocess.run(["git", "check-ignore", "--quiet", "--", probe],
+                                cwd=str(root), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+        if result.returncode != 0:
+            raise RuntimeError("tmp evidence namespace must already be ignored; no ignore rule changes permitted")
+    for folder in args.leaf_contract:
+        resolved = (root / folder).resolve()
+        if root / "docs" / "contracts" not in resolved.parents:
+            raise RuntimeError("Leaf contract must be a docs/contracts subtree")
+        if not resolved.is_dir():
+            raise RuntimeError("Leaf contract subtree missing")
+        args.owned_source.extend(path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
+                                 for path in resolved.rglob("*") if path.is_file())
+    dest = run / args.label
+    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    helper = Path(__file__).resolve().read_bytes()
+    create(dest / "capture-helper.py.txt", helper)
+    record = {"argv": argv, "cwd": str(root), "helper_sha256": digest(helper),
+              "evidence_namespace_excluded": run.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
+              "actual_evidence_namespace": str(run),
+              "evidence_port_boundary": "Receipts originate here; any later exact copy into RUN requires a separate port manifest. No contemporaneous canonical RUN claim.",
+              "owned_source": args.owned_source, "command_started": False, "actual_exit": None,
+              "ZIP_is_whole_repository_archive": False,
+              "ZIP_scope": "Selected active source/input trees and current leaf contracts; all historical runs excluded",
+              "full_RAW_inventory_scope": "Every library/Test source and enumerated current harness/site source/input tree plus current leaf contracts. Historical archives not separately RAW-hashed; committed HEAD and clean Git status bind repository state.",
+              "leaf_contract_roots": args.leaf_contract}
+    try:
+        before = inventory(root, run, args.owned_source)
+        record["pre_git"] = state(root)
+        if record["pre_git"]["status_porcelain_v1_z_hex"]:
+            raise RuntimeError("Clean committed candidate required before gate")
+        create(dest / "pre-source-inputs.json", before)
+        selected = [row for row in before if selected_for_zip(row["path"], args.leaf_contract)]
+        create(dest / "pre-selected-ZIP-inputs.json", selected)
+        record["ZIP_selected_files"] = len(selected)
+        record["full_RAW_inventory_files"] = len(before)
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(str(dest / "pre-selected-source-raw.zip"), "x", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
+            for row in selected:
+                data = (root / row["path"]).read_bytes()
+                if digest(data) != row["raw_sha256"]:
+                    raise RuntimeError("Source changed during snapshot: " + row["path"])
+                archive.writestr(row["path"], data)
+        if any(digest((root / row["path"]).read_bytes()) != row["raw_sha256"] for row in selected):
+            raise RuntimeError("Selected ZIP source changed before command")
+        if state(root) != record["pre_git"]:
+            raise RuntimeError("Git changed before command")
+        record["precommand_check"] = "Selected ZIP RAW hashes and Git state; no redundant second full inventory. Full pre/post manifests remain authoritative."
+        record["start_utc"] = utc()
+        record["command_started"] = True
+        with (dest / "stdout.raw").open("xb") as out, (dest / "stderr.raw").open("xb") as err:
+            proc = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=str(root), stdout=out, stderr=err,
+                                  env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1"))
+        record["end_utc"] = utc()
+        record["actual_exit"] = proc.returncode
+        after = inventory(root, run, args.owned_source)
+        create(dest / "post-source-inputs.json", after)
+        record["post_git"] = state(root)
+        record["complete_source_path_set_and_RAW_unchanged"] = before == after
+        record["HEAD_and_branch_unchanged"] = all(record["pre_git"][k] == record["post_git"][k]
+                                                 for k in ("HEAD", "branch"))
+        record["git_status_unchanged"] = record["pre_git"] == record["post_git"]
+        record["capture_integrity_ok"] = before == after and record["HEAD_and_branch_unchanged"] and record["git_status_unchanged"]
+    except Exception as exc:
+        record["capture_error"] = repr(exc)
+        record["capture_integrity_ok"] = False
+        record.setdefault("end_utc", utc())
+    for name in ("stdout.raw", "stderr.raw", "pre-source-inputs.json", "post-source-inputs.json",
+                 "pre-selected-ZIP-inputs.json", "pre-selected-source-raw.zip"):
+        path = dest / name
+        if path.exists():
+            record[name + "_sha256"] = digest(path.read_bytes())
+    create(dest / "receipt.json", record)
+    print(json.dumps({"receipt": str(dest / "receipt.json"), "actual_exit": record["actual_exit"],
+                      "capture_integrity_ok": record["capture_integrity_ok"]}))
+    if not record["capture_integrity_ok"]:
+        return 125
+    return record["actual_exit"] if record["actual_exit"] is not None else 125
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+"""Gate recorder reused for unbounded OGD, Python3.8 stdlib; no gate executed by preparation."""
+import argparse
+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import zipfile
+
+
+def utc():
+    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+
+
+def digest(data):
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def create(path, data):
+    if not isinstance(data, bytes):
+        data = (json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
+    with path.open("xb") as stream:
+        stream.write(data)
+
+
+def git(root, *args):
+    proc = subprocess.run(["git"] + list(args), cwd=str(root), stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                          stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+    if proc.returncode:
+        raise RuntimeError("git failed: " + repr(args) + ": " + proc.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace"))
+    return proc.stdout
+
+
+def state(root):
+    return {"HEAD": git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip(),
+            "branch": git(root, "branch", "--show-current").decode().strip(),
+            "status_porcelain_v1_z_hex": git(root, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z").hex()}
+
+
+def inventory(root, run, owned):
+    # Start with tracked names, then explicitly filter to current source/input trees below.
+    names = set(x.decode("utf-8") for x in git(root, "ls-files", "-z", "--cached").split(b"\0") if x)
+    # Add new source paths, including ignored additions inside actual source trees.
+    for folder in ("BanditRLProof", "Tests", "tools", "website/scripts", "website/content",
+                   "website/static", "research-wiki/contribution-contracts"):
+        for path in (root / folder).rglob("*"):
+            if path.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in path.parts:
+                names.add(path.relative_to(root).as_posix())
+    for name in ("BanditRLProof.lean", "Tests.lean", "lean-toolchain", "lakefile.lean",
+                 "lake-manifest.json", ".gitattributes"):
+        names.add(name)
+    names.update(owned)
+    contract_roots = [name.rsplit("/", 1)[0] for name in owned if name.startswith("docs/contracts/")]
+    extra = {"README.md", "AGENTS.md", "CONTRIBUTING.md", "docs/contribution-contract.schema.json", "docs/contributor-codex-contract.md", "docs/theorem-publication-protocol.md", "docs/contracts/online-book-v1/coverage.json"}
+    names = {name for name in names if selected_for_zip(name, contract_roots) or name in extra}
+    result = []
+    for name in sorted(names):
+        path = root / name
+        resolved = path.resolve()
+        if resolved == run or run in resolved.parents:
+            continue
+        if root not in resolved.parents or path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
+            raise RuntimeError("Input must be an existing ordinary repository file: " + name)
+        data = path.read_bytes()
+        result.append({"path": name, "raw_sha256": digest(data), "bytes": len(data)})
+    return result
+
+
+def selected_for_zip(name, contract_roots):
+    # Historical runs are excluded from both selected RAW inventory and ZIP; clean HEAD binds them.
+    if name.startswith("runs/"):
+        return False
+    prefixes = ("BanditRLProof/", "Tests/", "tools/", "website/scripts/",
+                "website/content/", "website/static/", "research-wiki/contribution-contracts/")
+    exact = {"BanditRLProof.lean", "Tests.lean", "lean-toolchain", "lakefile.lean",
+             "lake-manifest.json", ".gitattributes"}
+    return (name in exact or name.startswith(prefixes) or
+            any(name.startswith(folder.rstrip("/") + "/") for folder in contract_roots))
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--root", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--run", required=True, help="New evidence namespace beneath runs/ or an already ignored tmp/ namespace")
+    parser.add_argument("--label", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--owned-source", action="append", default=[])
+    parser.add_argument("--leaf-contract", action="append", required=True,
+                        help="Current leaf docs/contracts subtree to include in ZIP")
+    parser.add_argument("argv", nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    root = Path(args.root).resolve()
+    run = (root / args.run).resolve()
+    argv = args.argv[1:] if args.argv[:1] == ["--"] else args.argv
+    if not argv or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*", args.label):
+        raise RuntimeError("Exact argv and safe unique label required")
+    if root / "runs" not in run.parents and root / "tmp" not in run.parents:
+        raise RuntimeError("Evidence namespace must be beneath root/runs/ or root/tmp/")
+    if root / "tmp" in run.parents:
+        probe = run.relative_to(root).as_posix() + "/.capture-ignore-probe"
+        result = subprocess.run(["git", "check-ignore", "--quiet", "--", probe],
+                                cwd=str(root), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+        if result.returncode != 0:
+            raise RuntimeError("tmp evidence namespace must already be ignored; no ignore rule changes permitted")
+    for folder in args.leaf_contract:
+        resolved = (root / folder).resolve()
+        if root / "docs" / "contracts" not in resolved.parents:
+            raise RuntimeError("Leaf contract must be a docs/contracts subtree")
+        if not resolved.is_dir():
+            raise RuntimeError("Leaf contract subtree missing")
+        args.owned_source.extend(path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
+                                 for path in resolved.rglob("*") if path.is_file())
+    dest = run / args.label
+    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    helper = Path(__file__).resolve().read_bytes()
+    create(dest / "capture-helper.py.txt", helper)
+    record = {"argv": argv, "cwd": str(root), "helper_sha256": digest(helper),
+              "evidence_namespace_excluded": run.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
+              "actual_evidence_namespace": str(run),
+              "evidence_port_boundary": "Receipts originate here; any later exact copy into RUN requires a separate port manifest. No contemporaneous canonical RUN claim.",
+              "owned_source": args.owned_source, "command_started": False, "actual_exit": None,
+              "ZIP_is_whole_repository_archive": False,
+              "ZIP_scope": "Selected active source/input trees and current leaf contracts; all historical runs excluded",
+              "full_RAW_inventory_scope": "Every library/Test source and enumerated current harness/site source/input tree plus current leaf contracts. Historical archives not separately RAW-hashed; committed HEAD and clean Git status bind repository state.",
+              "leaf_contract_roots": args.leaf_contract}
+    try:
+        before = inventory(root, run, args.owned_source)
+        record["pre_git"] = state(root)
+        if record["pre_git"]["status_porcelain_v1_z_hex"]:
+            raise RuntimeError("Clean committed candidate required before gate")
+        create(dest / "pre-source-inputs.json", before)
+        selected = [row for row in before if selected_for_zip(row["path"], args.leaf_contract)]
+        create(dest / "pre-selected-ZIP-inputs.json", selected)
+        record["ZIP_selected_files"] = len(selected)
+        record["full_RAW_inventory_files"] = len(before)
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(str(dest / "pre-selected-source-raw.zip"), "x", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
+            for row in selected:
+                data = (root / row["path"]).read_bytes()
+                if digest(data) != row["raw_sha256"]:
+                    raise RuntimeError("Source changed during snapshot: " + row["path"])
+                archive.writestr(row["path"], data)
+        if any(digest((root / row["path"]).read_bytes()) != row["raw_sha256"] for row in selected):
+            raise RuntimeError("Selected ZIP source changed before command")
+        if state(root) != record["pre_git"]:
+            raise RuntimeError("Git changed before command")
+        record["precommand_check"] = "Selected ZIP RAW hashes and Git state; no redundant second full inventory. Full pre/post manifests remain authoritative."
+        record["start_utc"] = utc()
+        record["command_started"] = True
+        with (dest / "stdout.raw").open("xb") as out, (dest / "stderr.raw").open("xb") as err:
+            proc = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=str(root), stdout=out, stderr=err,
+                                  env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1"))
+        record["end_utc"] = utc()
+        record["actual_exit"] = proc.returncode
+        after = inventory(root, run, args.owned_source)
+        create(dest / "post-source-inputs.json", after)
+        record["post_git"] = state(root)
+        record["complete_source_path_set_and_RAW_unchanged"] = before == after
+        record["HEAD_and_branch_unchanged"] = all(record["pre_git"][k] == record["post_git"][k]
+                                                 for k in ("HEAD", "branch"))
+        record["git_status_unchanged"] = record["pre_git"] == record["post_git"]
+        record["capture_integrity_ok"] = before == after and record["HEAD_and_branch_unchanged"] and record["git_status_unchanged"]
+    except Exception as exc:
+        record["capture_error"] = repr(exc)
+        record["capture_integrity_ok"] = False
+        record.setdefault("end_utc", utc())
+    for name in ("stdout.raw", "stderr.raw", "pre-source-inputs.json", "post-source-inputs.json",
+                 "pre-selected-ZIP-inputs.json", "pre-selected-source-raw.zip"):
+        path = dest / name
+        if path.exists():
+            record[name + "_sha256"] = digest(path.read_bytes())
+    create(dest / "receipt.json", record)
+    print(json.dumps({"receipt": str(dest / "receipt.json"), "actual_exit": record["actual_exit"],
+                      "capture_integrity_ok": record["capture_integrity_ok"]}))
+    if not record["capture_integrity_ok"]:
+        return 125
+    return record["actual_exit"] if record["actual_exit"] is not None else 125
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+"""Gate recorder reused for unbounded OGD, Python3.8 stdlib; no gate executed by preparation."""
+import argparse
+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import zipfile
+
+
+def utc():
+    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+
+
+def digest(data):
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def create(path, data):
+    if not isinstance(data, bytes):
+        data = (json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
+    with path.open("xb") as stream:
+        stream.write(data)
+
+
+def git(root, *args):
+    proc = subprocess.run(["git"] + list(args), cwd=str(root), stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+                          stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+    if proc.returncode:
+        raise RuntimeError("git failed: " + repr(args) + ": " + proc.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace"))
+    return proc.stdout
+
+
+def state(root):
+    return {"HEAD": git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip(),
+            "branch": git(root, "branch", "--show-current").decode().strip(),
+            "status_porcelain_v1_z_hex": git(root, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z").hex()}
+
+
+def inventory(root, run, owned):
+    # Start with tracked names, then explicitly filter to current source/input trees below.
+    names = set(x.decode("utf-8") for x in git(root, "ls-files", "-z", "--cached").split(b"\0") if x)
+    # Add new source paths, including ignored additions inside actual source trees.
+    for folder in ("BanditRLProof", "Tests", "tools", "website/scripts", "website/content",
+                   "website/static", "research-wiki/contribution-contracts"):
+        for path in (root / folder).rglob("*"):
+            if path.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in path.parts:
+                names.add(path.relative_to(root).as_posix())
+    for name in ("BanditRLProof.lean", "Tests.lean", "lean-toolchain", "lakefile.lean",
+                 "lake-manifest.json", ".gitattributes"):
+        names.add(name)
+    names.update(owned)
+    contract_roots = [name.rsplit("/", 1)[0] for name in owned if name.startswith("docs/contracts/")]
+    extra = {"README.md", "AGENTS.md", "CONTRIBUTING.md", "docs/contribution-contract.schema.json", "docs/contributor-codex-contract.md", "docs/theorem-publication-protocol.md", "docs/contracts/online-book-v1/coverage.json"}
+    names = {name for name in names if selected_for_zip(name, contract_roots) or name in extra}
+    result = []
+    for name in sorted(names):
+        path = root / name
+        resolved = path.resolve()
+        if resolved == run or run in resolved.parents:
+            continue
+        if root not in resolved.parents or path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
+            raise RuntimeError("Input must be an existing ordinary repository file: " + name)
+        data = path.read_bytes()
+        result.append({"path": name, "raw_sha256": digest(data), "bytes": len(data)})
+    return result
+
+
+def selected_for_zip(name, contract_roots):
+    # Historical runs are excluded from both selected RAW inventory and ZIP; clean HEAD binds them.
+    if name.startswith("runs/"):
+        return False
+    prefixes = ("BanditRLProof/", "Tests/", "tools/", "website/scripts/",
+                "website/content/", "website/static/", "research-wiki/contribution-contracts/")
+    exact = {"BanditRLProof.lean", "Tests.lean", "lean-toolchain", "lakefile.lean",
+             "lake-manifest.json", ".gitattributes"}
+    return (name in exact or name.startswith(prefixes) or
+            any(name.startswith(folder.rstrip("/") + "/") for folder in contract_roots))
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--root", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--run", required=True, help="New evidence namespace beneath runs/ or an already ignored tmp/ namespace")
+    parser.add_argument("--label", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--owned-source", action="append", default=[])
+    parser.add_argument("--leaf-contract", action="append", required=True,
+                        help="Current leaf docs/contracts subtree to include in ZIP")
+    parser.add_argument("argv", nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    root = Path(args.root).resolve()
+    run = (root / args.run).resolve()
+    argv = args.argv[1:] if args.argv[:1] == ["--"] else args.argv
+    if not argv or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*", args.label):
+        raise RuntimeError("Exact argv and safe unique label required")
+    if root / "runs" not in run.parents and root / "tmp" not in run.parents:
+        raise RuntimeError("Evidence namespace must be beneath root/runs/ or root/tmp/")
+    if root / "tmp" in run.parents:
+        probe = run.relative_to(root).as_posix() + "/.capture-ignore-probe"
+        result = subprocess.run(["git", "check-ignore", "--quiet", "--", probe],
+                                cwd=str(root), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+        if result.returncode != 0:
+            raise RuntimeError("tmp evidence namespace must already be ignored; no ignore rule changes permitted")
+    for folder in args.leaf_contract:
+        resolved = (root / folder).resolve()
+        if root / "docs" / "contracts" not in resolved.parents:
+            raise RuntimeError("Leaf contract must be a docs/contracts subtree")
+        if not resolved.is_dir():
+            raise RuntimeError("Leaf contract subtree missing")
+        args.owned_source.extend(path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
+                                 for path in resolved.rglob("*") if path.is_file())
+    dest = run / args.label
+    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    helper = Path(__file__).resolve().read_bytes()
+    create(dest / "capture-helper.py.txt", helper)
+    record = {"argv": argv, "cwd": str(root), "helper_sha256": digest(helper),
+              "evidence_namespace_excluded": run.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
+              "actual_evidence_namespace": str(run),
+              "evidence_port_boundary": "Receipts originate here; any later exact copy into RUN requires a separate port manifest. No contemporaneous canonical RUN claim.",
+              "owned_source": args.owned_source, "command_started": False, "actual_exit": None,
+              "ZIP_is_whole_repository_archive": False,
+              "ZIP_scope": "Selected active source/input trees and current leaf contracts; all historical runs excluded",
+              "full_RAW_inventory_scope": "Every library/Test source and enumerated current harness/site source/input tree plus current leaf contracts. Historical archives not separately RAW-hashed; committed HEAD and clean Git status bind repository state.",
+              "leaf_contract_roots": args.leaf_contract}
+    try:
+        before = inventory(root, run, args.owned_source)
+        record["pre_git"] = state(root)
+        if record["pre_git"]["status_porcelain_v1_z_hex"]:
+            raise RuntimeError("Clean committed candidate required before gate")
+        create(dest / "pre-source-inputs.json", before)
+        selected = [row for row in before if selected_for_zip(row["path"], args.leaf_contract)]
+        create(dest / "pre-selected-ZIP-inputs.json", selected)
+        record["ZIP_selected_files"] = len(selected)
+        record["full_RAW_inventory_files"] = len(before)
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(str(dest / "pre-selected-source-raw.zip"), "x", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
+            for row in selected:
+                data = (root / row["path"]).read_bytes()
+                if digest(data) != row["raw_sha256"]:
+                    raise RuntimeError("Source changed during snapshot: " + row["path"])
+                archive.writestr(row["path"], data)
+        if any(digest((root / row["path"]).read_bytes()) != row["raw_sha256"] for row in selected):
+            raise RuntimeError("Selected ZIP source changed before command")
+        if state(root) != record["pre_git"]:
+            raise RuntimeError("Git changed before command")
+        record["precommand_check"] = "Selected ZIP RAW hashes and Git state; no redundant second full inventory. Full pre/post manifests remain authoritative."
+        record["start_utc"] = utc()
+        record["command_started"] = True
+        with (dest / "stdout.raw").open("xb") as out, (dest / "stderr.raw").open("xb") as err:
+            proc = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=str(root), stdout=out, stderr=err,
+                                  env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1"))
+        record["end_utc"] = utc()
+        record["actual_exit"] = proc.returncode
+        after = inventory(root, run, args.owned_source)
+        create(dest / "post-source-inputs.json", after)
+        record["post_git"] = state(root)
+        record["complete_source_path_set_and_RAW_unchanged"] = before == after
+        record["HEAD_and_branch_unchanged"] = all(record["pre_git"][k] == record["post_git"][k]
+                                                 for k in ("HEAD", "branch"))
+        record["git_status_unchanged"] = record["pre_git"] == record["post_git"]
+        record["capture_integrity_ok"] = before == after and record["HEAD_and_branch_unchanged"] and record["git_status_unchanged"]
+    except Exception as exc:
+        record["capture_error"] = repr(exc)
+        record["capture_integrity_ok"] = False
+        record.setdefault("end_utc", utc())
+    for name in ("stdout.raw", "stderr.raw", "pre-source-inputs.json", "post-source-inputs.json",
+                 "pre-selected-ZIP-inputs.json", "pre-selected-source-raw.zip"):
+        path = dest / name
+        if path.exists():
+            record[name + "_sha256"] = digest(path.read_bytes())
+    create(dest / "receipt.json", record)
+    print(json.dumps({"receipt": str(dest / "receipt.json"), "actual_exit": record["actual_exit"],
+                      "capture_integrity_ok": record["capture_integrity_ok"]}))
+    if not record["capture_integrity_ok"]:
+        return 125
+    return record["actual_exit"] if record["actual_exit"] is not None else 125
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
